_doc: Edit + commit this file on a render/** branch to start a cloud render (works from the GitHub phone app). production = folder in studio/productions; composition = id in src/Root.tsx (use the 1080x1920 one); frames = a-b or 'all'; workers = parallel free runners (1-8); audio = 'mix' to mux productions/<production>/audio/mix.wav, or 'none'; qc = 'full' runs the complete QC (frame count, narration sync + clarity, loop), 'basic' for partial ranges; release = true attaches the MP4 to a GitHub Release (easy phone download).
note: TwistFrame Lab: London's Secret Underground Mail Railway v1.1 - hero framing in the street, descent framing, single lamp bulbs (1801 frames, native 1080x1920)
